question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Compatible
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **'Inconsistent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Compatible (अनुकूल)** - Capable of existing or performing in harmonious combination.

 
 
• **Example: **His skills are very compatible with the requirements of the job.
 
 
 
• **Inconsistent (अनियमित)** - Not staying the same throughout.
 
 
• **Example:** His inconsistent performance at work has raised some concerns.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'Inconsistent' is the antonym of 'Compatible'.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Compatible'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Energetic (ऊर्जावान)** - Having or showing a lot of energy or activity.

 
 
• **Example: **She is an energetic leader always inspiring her team.
 
 
 
• **Immaculate (निर्मल / बेदाग)** - Perfectly clean, neat, or tidy.
 
 
• **Example: **The house was in an immaculate condition for the guests to arrive.
 
 
 
• **Helpful (सहायक)** - Providing useful help or services.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher was extremely helpful in making the concepts clearer.
 
 

62:Tb4f,

The correct answer is Option (2)</str
